note: Route-graph ratchet baseline (no-new-rot ratchet). Each entry is the CURRENT reachable-first-party-module-count ceiling for a LOCKED FIXED_ROUTES route (the primary dev-perf 'first-party graph pressure' metric from scripts/route-graph.mjs). The gate fails when a tracked route's count grows BEYOND its ceiling and when the committed baseline raises any ceiling vs the base branch WITHOUT a matching absorb record. Counts are captured WITH the companion extension repos cloned pinned (exactly as CI does via clone-extensions) so they reproduce in CI. Regenerate with `node scripts/audit/route-graph-ratchet.mjs --write-baseline` after cloning the extensions — a ceiling should only ever be LOWERED as barrel imports are narrowed, and is never raised SILENTLY. A sanctioned raise must be ANNOTATED: a sibling `absorbs` record `route -> { from, to, reason, pr }` whose from/to exactly match the raise vs the base branch (from = the base ceiling, to = the new committed ceiling, reason = why the growth is accepted, pr = the PR carrying the absorbed change). The gate validates records strictly (malformed/stale/orphan records fail closed; a carried-forward record may not be deleted while its raised ceiling is kept) and prints a LOUD NOTICE line for every absorbed raise. The tracked route set is route-graph.mjs FIXED_ROUTES; change it there, then regenerate.

/sign-in.reason: cinatra#1037 P2a (PR #1304): /sign-in reaches drizzle-store (auth -> DB) but NOT the chat runner, so it gains EXACTLY 1 first-party leaf: src/lib/assistant-thread-schema.ts (the new pure-strings bootstrap-DDL leaf for the assistant_threads/assistant_turns tables, imported by drizzle-store.ts). The four assistant-runtime leaves stay off /sign-in's graph. Delta measured B-A on the identical tree. Absorbed raise 135->136 (rebased onto a main whose ceilings already include cinatra#1317's +1 co-owner-constraint leaf; counts re-measured with --write-baseline on the merged tree, companion extensions cloned pinned).

/api/mcp.reason: cinatra#1037 P2a (PR #1304): the assistant runtime-core extraction. runChatTurn moves out of src/app/api/chat/runner.ts into the assistant_config-parameterized runtime (src/lib/assistant-runtime/runtime.ts); runner.ts delegates to it, and the two new tables' bootstrap DDL is extracted into the pure-strings leaf src/lib/assistant-thread-schema.ts (imported by drizzle-store.ts, the file-size-ratchet bottleneck). Every locked route that reaches BOTH the chat runner AND drizzle-store gains EXACTLY 5 first-party leaves: (1) src/lib/assistant-runtime/runtime.ts (the extracted runtime), (2) src/lib/assistant-runtime/ports.ts (the runtime config/ports module), (3) src/lib/assistant-runtime/cinatra-assistant-config.ts (the Cinatra reference config), (4) src/lib/assistant-config.ts (the P1 sidecar, now VALUE-reachable via the reference config's assistantConfigSchema import; on the base it was only TYPE-reachable through drizzle-store, so uncounted), and (5) src/lib/assistant-thread-schema.ts (the new bootstrap-DDL leaf, reached from drizzle-store). None has a companion-repo edge, so each is one leaf. Delta measured B-A on identical trees with the same unresolved-edge offset (111). Absorbed raise 1390->1395 (rebased onto a main whose ceilings already include cinatra#1317's +1 co-owner-constraint leaf; counts re-measured with --write-baseline on the merged tree, companion extensions cloned pinned).
